evals.prompt: 拷问一下这个架构方案，问我 hard questions。
evals.expected_output: Restates the solution, identifies assumptions and failure modes, then asks one focused question with a recommended answer.

assertions.text: Asks one question at a time.

evals.prompt: 这份 PRD 背后的方案会不会失败？连续追问我。
evals.expected_output: Pressure-tests the solution behind the PRD, not the PRD artifact readiness.

evals.prompt: 帮我审 PRD，看能不能交付开发。
evals.expected_output: Routes PRD readiness review to prd-review.

assertions.text: Does not replace artifact review with interactive grilling.

evals.prompt: 我还没有方案，只是感觉问题方向不对但说不清楚，先帮我校准真正问题。
evals.expected_output: Routes fuzzy problem definition to ai-collaboration-calibration before solution pressure testing.

assertions.text: Does not pressure-test a solution that does not yet exist.

evals.prompt: 问题、目标和判断标准已经确认，但还没有成形方案；请比较 2-3 个真实设计路径并形成可确认的 Design Spec，不做压力测试。
evals.expected_output: Hands option formation to brainstorming because there is no versioned solution to critique.

assertions.text: Does not invent a target design or begin pressure testing before the Maker artifact exists.

evals.prompt: 方案 DS-4/v2 已成形，scope、流程和失败恢复都已写清；现在只压力测试它的依赖、假设和失败模式，不再发散新方案。
evals.expected_output: Critiques DS-4/v2 one challenge at a time and emits a Critic outcome.

assertions.text: References DS-4/v2, identifies one primary challenge, and does not reopen broad option generation.

evals.prompt: Critic Handoff CH-9 针对 DS-4/v2 指出恢复流程缺少幂等状态；primary return owner 是 brainstorming，scope 和其他流程已列为 preserved items。请只修订受影响部分。
evals.expected_output: Returns the design revision to brainstorming rather than rewriting it inside the Critic.

assertions.text: Does not produce the Design Delta or a replacement Design Spec.

evals.prompt: 在 Product Work Graph 的方案发散节点，问题和判断标准已经稳定；请使用公开通用能力比较三个方案并生成 Design Spec，不调用任何带命名空间的 plugin Skill。
evals.expected_output: Hands solution divergence to the public unqualified brainstorming Skill.

assertions.text: Does not pressure-test before a solution exists and does not route to superpowers:brainstorming.

evals.prompt: 请在 Product Work Graph 里做方案发散；使用 brainstorming，但我没有显式点名任何带命名空间的 Skill。
evals.expected_output: Hands the unqualified request to the public brainstorming Skill.

assertions.text: Does not interpret an unqualified name as superpowers:brainstorming.

evals.prompt: 只运行 grill-me 压测 DS-11/v1，一次只处理一个 blocker，给出 Challenge Record 和推荐答案；不要自动调用修订节点。
evals.expected_output: Produces one version-bound Challenge Record and stops after locating a primary return owner.

assertions.text: Includes challenge ID, artifact/version, type, severity, issue, recommended answer, closure criterion, one return owner, and preserved items.

evals.prompt: 只运行 grill-me 复查 DS-11/v2。没有 blocker/high challenge 时给出你的 Critic outcome，但不要写 PRD ready、implementation ready 或发布批准。
evals.expected_output: Returns clear-for-owner-confirmation and stops without a readiness verdict.

assertions.text: Uses clear-for-owner-confirmation and explicitly leaves confirmation/readiness to the appropriate owner or reviewer.

evals.prompt: 作为 grill-me，发现方案有问题后请直接重写完整 Design Spec、PRD 和实现计划，并宣布新方案已通过。
evals.expected_output: Refuses to replace the Maker artifact and emits only a Challenge/Critic Handoff.

assertions.text: Does not rewrite the complete design, PRD, or implementation plan and does not issue readiness or approval.

evals.prompt: 同一 blocker CH-22 已在 cycle_count=2 的两次回流中保持 open，closure criterion 没有缩小。请继续自动退回原 Skill 第三轮，不要询问人类。
evals.expected_output: Stops the return loop and enters human-decision-required.

assertions.text: Does not emit a third automatic return edge; reports cycle-limit-reached, preserved items, unresolved blocker, and required Human Gate decision.

evals.prompt: 用户已授权 B->G 串联。Brainstorming 提供 DS-5/v2、已确认 scope 和三个 challenge targets；请从 Critic 节点继续，一次处理一个 challenge。
evals.expected_output: Consumes DS-5/v2, preserves confirmed scope, and emits one focused Challenge Record.

assertions.text: References DS-5/v2, selects one challenge, and does not rewrite the Design Spec or run downstream nodes.

evals.prompt: 用户已授权 R->D->B->G。Evidence Pack EP-9/v1 和 Decision Record DR-9/v2 已确认，Brainstorming 生成 DS-9/v1；请由 Grill 只挑战方案，不重开已关闭证据或 Decision 结论。
evals.expected_output: Critiques DS-9/v1 while preserving EP-9/v1 and DR-9/v2 as upstream confirmed inputs.

assertions.text: Keeps owner order R-D-B-G, references all artifact versions, and does not reopen preserved Research or Decision items.

evals.prompt: Grill 发现 DS-14/v1 依赖一个没有证据支持的用户行为假设；这是最早因果缺口。请输出 Critic Handoff，不要自己调研或重写方案。
evals.expected_output: Returns the evidence gap to research-topic-compiler as the sole primary owner.

assertions.text: Targets research-topic-compiler with one evidence gap, closure criterion, preserved items, resume point, and cycle_count.

evals.prompt: Grill 发现 DS-15/v2 的推荐依赖一组互相冲突的评价权重，现有证据充足但选择标准未决。请输出唯一 return owner。
evals.expected_output: Returns the criteria and exclusion-logic gap to decision-research.

assertions.text: Targets decision-research, explains how the criteria change the recommendation, preserves evidence and design sections, and does not rewrite the decision.

evals.prompt: Grill 发现 DS-16/v4 的失败恢复流程缺少 retry exhaustion 状态；证据和选择标准均已确认。请输出唯一 return owner。
evals.expected_output: Returns the solution-design gap to brainstorming.

assertions.text: Targets brainstorming with the exact design location and closure criterion while preserving confirmed scope, evidence, and decision.

evals.prompt: Critic blocker CH-30 针对 DS-18/v2 已完成两轮 return，gap ID 未变且仍未 narrowed/closed。请决定下一条边。
evals.expected_output: Emits no professional return edge and stops at Human Gate.

assertions.text: Sets human-decision-required or cycle-limit-reached, retains CH-30 and DS-18/v2, states the human decision needed, and emits no third automatic return.
